overview: Jordan is a country in Western Asia, east of the Jordan River. Its capital and largest city is Amman. Jordan is a kingdom and became independent from British administration in 1946. It is home to Petra, an ancient city carved into rose-coloured rock, and it has taken in large numbers of refugees from neighbouring countries.

geography.text: Most of Jordan is desert, including the dramatic valley of Wadi Rum in the south. In the west, the Jordan Rift Valley runs down to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on land. Jordan's only coast is a short stretch on the Gulf of Aqaba, an arm of the Red Sea.
